buy_title: The exact Instant Pot models to order, and what to check on the listing
buy_total: The buttons show today's price; as an Amazon Associate we earn from qualifying purchases, and it never changes what you pay. List prices in this guide come from Instant Pot's own store, October 2026.
buy_kicker: Our first pick, and our last word

cards.name: Instant Pot Duo 6-Quart 7-in-1 (model 112-0170-01)
cards.badge: Our first pick · the safe buy for most kitchens
cards.price: List $109.99 at Instant Pot's store (October 2026); past sales ran about 30%–40% off list
cards.buy_if: you want the plain, proven pressure cooker for rice, beans, stews and chili, with the most owners and the most recipes behind it.
cards.skip_if: you want sous vide or a quieter steam release (Duo Plus), or insulated pot handles and more power (Pro); America's Test Kitchen also found the Duo slow-cooks poorly.
cards.owners: About 4.6 out of 5 across roughly 3,100 to 3,400 Walmart ratings (search snippet, October 2026); Food Network named it best overall (February 2025).
cards.video_title: Instant Pot Duo Better Than Instant Pot Rio? Should You Upgrade?
cards.video_why: The only video we found that sets the Duo directly against the Rio, side by side; the title came from a search-result URL.

buy.pick: The 6-quart Duo 7-in-1, model 112-0170-01 (also sold as IP-DUO60). Not the 8-quart, the Duo Nova or the Duo Crisp.
buy.check: Sold by Amazon.com or Instant Pot (the one-year warranty covers authorized retailers only); the title says Duo, 7-in-1 and 6 Qt; the model number matches.
buy.label: See today's price

cards.name: Instant Pot Duo Plus 6-Quart 9-in-1 (Whisper Quiet, model 112-0169-01)
cards.badge: The upgrade · worth it only on sale
cards.price: List $139.99 at Instant Pot's store (October 2026); sale depth reported up to about 57% off in November 2025
cards.buy_if: you will really use sous vide or cake, you want a quieter steam release, or you want two spare sealing rings in the box.
cards.skip_if: you only pressure-cook rice, beans and soup: the pot and power match the Duo, and Tom's Guide found the rice program weaker.
cards.owners: 4.7 out of 5 across 765 Best Buy reviews (October 2026); the Target bundle version is a different unit at 4.06 across 780 reviews.
cards.video_title: Instant Pot Duo Plus vs. Instant Pot Duo
cards.video_why: Shows what the Plus adds over the Duo; it appears to cover an older Plus generation, so check the buttons against the V4.

buy.pick: The Duo Plus 6-quart Whisper Quiet, model 112-0169-01, when it is within about $20 of the Duo.
buy.check: The model number 112-0169-01 in the listing; not the Target-exclusive 6QT bundle (112-2356-01), which is a different unit; two extra sealing rings in the box.
buy.label: See today's price

cards.name: Instant Pot Rio 6-Quart 7-in-1 (model 112-0312-01)
cards.badge: The one to check twice · same list price as the Duo
cards.chip: high pressure only · no pot handles
cards.buy_if: you find it clearly cheaper than the Duo and like the slimmer look and the time-only display.
cards.skip_if: you want a low-pressure setting for eggs or delicate foods, or a pot with handles; the Walmart Rio Chef Series is a different cooker with a coated aluminum pot.
cards.owners: 3.9 out of 5 across 247 Target reviews, 20% of them one star (October 2026); Best Buy showed 4.5 across 47 (search snippet).

cards.name: Instant Pot Pro 6-Quart 10-in-1 (model 112-0123-01)
cards.badge: The step up · more power and handles
cards.buy_if: you cook on it most days and want the insulated pot handles, more power and a flat pot for searing; America's Test Kitchen's winner was the 8-quart Pro.
cards.skip_if: you are buying your first pressure cooker; the Duo does the same core jobs for $60 less at list.
cards.owners: We found no reliable 6-quart Pro owner ratings at non-Amazon stores, so we do not rate it; Slickdeals posters (2025–2026) praise the handles.
